title: Governed Manifold Specification v1.1 — Amendment Edition: Formal Mathematical Foundation of the Autonomy Substrate
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: This record is part of an open-book, AI-assisted research program published under an audit-and-correction doctrine. Every record is audited; errors are corrected only through disclosed, versioned amendments (original versions preserved in the version history). Audit ledger and correction receipts: github.com/LLong2026/squirrel-os-lindy-test. This material is a prototype, provided for educational and research purposes only; it is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments.

Amendment Edition v1.1 (38 pp = 32 pp v1.0 + 6 pp disclosed amendment + audit log). The Governed Manifold Specification defines the formal mathematical object underlying autonomous-agent governance: the state–action product space Ω = S × A, a ten-invariant constraint family {I_k}, the admissible manifold 𝓜 as an intersection of zero-sublevel sets of Lipschitz constraint functions, transition constraints, barrier certificates and the Nagumo condition, the safety envelope Σ, and the governance invariance theorem. It applies established safe-control theory (invariant sets, barrier certificates, Lyapunov stability, Nagumo–Bony invariance) to AI governance.

Per the append-only doctrine, this edition discloses the author-directed independent audit of Oct 4, 2026, which corrected seven defects in the v1.0 draft (AI-assisted) — including a sign inversion in the Action Admissibility invariant I2 (as written, it scored forbidden actions as admissible), a circular hypothesis in the main Governance Theorem (re-derived via the Nagumo–Bony route), a malformed irreversibility definition (I7), and a discontinuous scope invariant (I10) that silently violated the Lipschitz premise and admitted zero safety margin. The amendment also reconciles the ten-invariant family to the deployed 12-article Constitution, maps every invariant to its constitutional article, discloses the uncovered articles (kill switch, PQC enforcement, privacy), and proposes invariants I11 (Kill-Switch Availability) and I12 (PQC Precondition) for a future version. Status: Audited (per the principal's ruling — not "Canonical"). Constraint function values are analytic constructs, not measured production quantities.

Theory companion to pending filings 64/157,915 (Deterministic Constitutional Autonomous Infrastructure) and 64/119,191 (Deterministically Governed Probabilistic Neural Computation). v1.0 preserved unchanged inside this edition per the disclosed-versioning doctrine. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
